description: A real subagent runs the seed's test suite, which fails. The installed trace hook must record the failed Bash call as an error/tool_error event read from that subagent's own transcript, with no agent calling optimize trace log.
why: The gate the trace-failure-capture investigation set (docs/specs/investigations/features/trace-failure-capture.md): the unit test proves the extractor on a fixture shaped like a real transcript, and this run proves the host writes that transcript and the installed hook reads it. The step persists its session, because without persistence the host writes no per-agent transcripts, and every earlier harness model run had it off.

steps.prompt: Use the Task tool to start exactly one general-purpose subagent with this instruction: "Run `npm test` once in the project root and report its exit code and the first line that mentions a failure. Do not change any file and do not run anything else." When it returns, reply with the exit code it reported and nothing else.
steps.why: The seed's suite fails, so the subagent's shell call returns a non-zero exit code: a failed tool result in its own transcript. First run 2026-09-28 on Windows: the host ran it through its PowerShell tool, the installed hook captured one failure with token_source agent-transcript, spend $0.50.

At least one failed shell call (Bash, or PowerShell on Windows) was captured, and at least one completion carries tool counts, so the hook read the agent's own transcript. `problems` must be present, so a crash cannot pass.
